description: Combine the new n=256 graph/no-copy global leader with the stage-specific n=1024 cap64/cap72 residency winner. Import the complete n=1024 LD68/LD72 aliased workspace, shortened helper live ranges, full carveout, operators, and launch bindings while preserving graph-captured direct-input n=256, cp.async large shapes, n=4096 replay, every other dispatch, caller-stream semantics, caches, fresh inputs, and the full grid.

Integrated only Brief68's final n1024 residency path into the direct-input graph n256 parent: LD68/LD72 aliased 35.84 KiB workspace, shortened update/solve descriptor lifetimes, full shared carveout, cap64 on the 720/480-block bulk stages, and cap72 on the 240-block tail. The graph-captured n256 stages, cp.async large paths, n4096 replay, caller stream, caches, and every other dispatch remain unchanged. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Batch60/n1024 measured 968.977 us (best 939.264), batch64/n256 112.626 us (best 96.382 with one 3.30 ms outlier), batch8/n2048 2436.991 us (best 1907.168 with one 103.7 ms outlier), and aggregate 805.174 us versus first-parent 786.229. Existing exact parent-line captures were read; hosted profiling is queued for the next run-wide rolling-hour slot.

Acted on Trial0's exact hosted index7 capture: the shortened-lifetime cap64 bulk panel used 64 registers with zero spills, 35.84 KiB shared, four-block register residency, 38.19% achieved occupancy, 43.36% no-eligible cycles, and a 1.22-wave 720-block launch whose 128-block partial wave was the explicit profile opening. Lowered only the 720/480-block bulk operator to cap48 so five resident CTAs can cover 720 blocks in one wave; cap72 tail, LD68/LD72 alias, full carveout, n256 graph, and all other paths stayed fixed. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 measured 967.868 us (best 948.192) versus cap64 Trial0 968.977 (best 939.264), while an unrelated 196.9 ms n2048 outlier lifted aggregate to 811.933 us versus Trial0 805.174.

Used Trial1's exact hosted profile to isolate the one-wave cap48 tradeoff by physical stage: cap48 only on the 720-block first panel, restored spill-free cap64 on the already-single-wave 480-block middle panel, and retained cap72 on the 240-block tail. The exact Trial1 capture showed cap48 achieved five-block residency, 0.97 waves, and 46.06% occupancy versus cap64's four blocks/1.22 waves/38.19%, but introduced 322.56 KiB spill requests and measured 205.25 us versus cap64's 204.38 us; this trial keeps that trade only where it changes wave count. Slice build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch60/n1024 improved from Trial1 967.868 to 934.268 us (best 929.408), matching the second parent's 934.857; aggregate improved to 799.959 despite a 172 ms n2048 outlier and n32768 drift.
